summary_en: Annual dividend raised to 110 yen/share from 80 yen for FY3/27, driven by uplifted full-year profit guidance to 560 billion yen (69.7% above prior forecast). Payout ratio maintained at 30%+ policy floor. Q2 interim dividend held at 40 yen; year-end dividend increased to 70 yen from 40 yen.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Operating Performance Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for FY2027/3
translation_en_brief: Tamai Steamship revised its FY3/27 dividend forecast upward following significant earnings upgrades announced 5 August 2026. The company raised its full-year consolidated net profit attributable to parent shareholders from 330 billion yen to 560 billion yen (69.7% increase), driven by stronger shipping markets in Q1 following Middle East disruptions and favorable foreign exchange outcomes (actual 159.37 yen vs. 150 yen forecast). The annual dividend per share was increased to 110 yen from 80 yen. The interim dividend (Q2) remains 40 yen; the year-end dividend (period-end) was raised to 70 yen from 40 yen. The company operates a floor policy setting minimum annual dividend at 80 yen per share and targets a consolidated payout ratio of 30% or higher, balancing sustainable growth investment with shareholder returns.
